summary: Chooses one POP input by numeric index and can optionally blend between adjacent inputs for fractional index values. Inputs may have different point, vertex, and primitive counts, but blending requires compatible lengths.

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: Input index; fractional values can blend adjacent inputs

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Index extend behavior such as clamp, loop, or zigzag

key_params.name: lengthmismatchnotif
key_params.note: Notification behavior for length mismatch during blending

key_params.name: lengthmismatchaction
key_params.note: How mismatched input lengths are sampled during blending

key_params.name: pointattrscope
key_params.note: Point attributes to switch or blend

key_params.name: primattrscope
key_params.note: Primitive attributes to switch or blend

key_params.name: vertattrscope
key_params.note: Vertex attributes to switch or blend

key_params.name: input0pop
key_params.note: POP source for an input block

key_concepts: Outputs one selected POP input unchanged when Index is an integer.
Fractional Index values can blend adjacent inputs when Blend between Inputs is enabled.
Extend controls clamp, loop, or zigzag behavior for indices outside the input range, including negative indices.
Point, primitive, and vertex attribute scopes choose which attributes participate in switching or blending.
common_gotchas: Fractional blending only works meaningfully when adjacent inputs have compatible element counts and attributes.
Clamp, loop, and zigzag extend modes change behavior outside the input index range.
Validate integer/uint attribute blending on older builds; recent builds include fixes in this area.
